content: Fullscreen API: element.requestFullscreen() must be called from within a user-gesture event handler (click) or it is rejected; it returns a Promise that resolves on success. document.exitFullscreen() reverses it. Listen for the 'fullscreenchange' event on document to detect both programmatic and user-initiated exits (e.g. pressing Esc or swiping away), checking document.fullscreenElement to determine current state -- do not rely solely on your own toggle state.
